path_and_handle_policy.root_path: latent implementation reads an exact canonical absolute DOS drive path only from the opaque grant capability; no caller request field supplies it; UNC, extended, device, ADS, slash, dot, reserved, trailing-dot-space, malformed UTF16, and aliases refused
path_and_handle_policy.root_open: CreateFileW opens only the fixed drive root with OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS plus FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, and FILE_SHARE_READ only; each grant-root component is then a relative NtOpenFile
path_and_handle_policy.descendant_open: every grant-root and request component uses NtOpenFile OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES.RootDirectory against the retained parent and exactly one validated component
path_and_handle_policy.share: FILE_SHARE_READ only for every root, component, target, and listed-child object; write and delete sharing denied
path_and_handle_policy.lifetime: root, traversed components, target, and each reported list child retained and identity-revalidated through successful response
path_and_handle_policy.reparse: FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT then exact handle attribute rejection
path_and_handle_policy.alternate_data_streams: colon is refused in every caller or enumerated component

security_policy.root_identity: exact FILE_ID_INFO volume serial and 128-bit file ID carried only by a future authenticated broker-issued capability
security_policy.current_user: non-service current process token user SID
security_policy.acl: every grant-root component and request/list target must be owned by current user and have a protected, nondefaulted DACL with exactly one noninherited FILE_ALL_ACCESS allow ACE for that SID; the fixed volume root is identity-held but exempt
security_policy.receipt: finite metadata only; no root, relative path, SID, user, file text, list names, OS error, or free-form diagnostic

volume_policy.all_objects: FILE_ID_INFO volume serial must equal the independent root grant

object_policy.type: FILE_TYPE_DISK file or directory matching the fixed operation
object_policy.read_encoding: strict UTF-8 only; embedded NUL is binary_refused; invalid or partial UTF-8 is utf8_required
object_policy.list: each record name is bounded by that record's validated NextEntryOffset before validation; each name is then independently relative-opened and inspected before inclusion; any unsafe/raced entry fails the whole call

cancellation.checks: latent checkpoints are insufficient for blocking native calls; public execution refuses until a genuinely cancellable or killable native I/O boundary exists
cancellation.blocking_io: NtOpenFile, GetFileInformationByHandleEx enumeration, and synchronous ReadFile are unreachable from the public entrypoint in this slice
cancellation.failure_output: no file text, entries, stat result, or retained lease

residual_gates: authenticated broker capability issuer with operation arguments deadline nonce and root identity MAC binding
genuinely cancellable worker/overlapped or supervised fail-stop boundary covering open enumeration and read

signed and manifest-pinned helper/library artifact design
authenticated bounded foreground transport and supervision
target NTFS ACL and NtOpenFile RootDirectory acceptance
filter-driver, antivirus, concurrent rename, reparse, hardlink, cancellation, and exhaustion testing
host policy integration without weakening the current Windows refusal
